_readme: The watch exits non-zero on any finding that is NOT covered here, which is
what turns the Catalog watch workflow red and sends the failure email. So a
red run always means something genuinely new. Silence means nothing changed.
Two ways to cover a finding:
acks  — one exact finding key, e.g. "missing_single:711520". Use for a
specific product we have looked at and decided about.
rules — a regex over the finding's name, scoped to one kind. Use for a
whole class we deliberately do not model, so a new member of that
EVERY entry needs a real `why`. This file is a decision record — an entry
with no reason is indistinguishable from sweeping something under the rug,
and the next person cannot tell whether it is still true.
Acknowledge from the command line rather than hand-editing:

rules.why: Pack-insert puzzle pieces. 79 SKUs and growing one set at a time; we model the finished Ravensburger puzzles (SEALED_PUZZLES) but not the insert fragments. Revisit only if we decide to track inserts as a collectible class.

Pack-insert collectible cards (RoJ 19, Archazia 20, Winterspell 9, Whispers 18). Same call as the puzzle inserts — a category we have never modelled. NOT the spin-dial lore counters, which we now track in the Sealed collection.
Reign of Jafar Hourglass/Gray/Red inserts — same insert class as above.

card_no_pid:Lorcana Challenge Year 3|16.why: Down In New Orleans — Challenge promo, same as #15.

card_no_pid:PD1|1.why: Beast - Snowfield Troublemaker. No TCGplayer listing found under this PD1 numbering (673338 is the older #31 promo, a different printing). Nothing to link until TCGplayer lists it — and when they do it arrives as an unacknowledged missing_single, so this ack cannot hide it.

card_no_pid:PD1|2.why: Rapunzel - Ethereal Protector. TCGplayer pid 711443 is almost certainly it — same name, same collector number #2, in the promo group that matches PD1 #2-#8 exactly. One line in TCG_PID_OVERRIDES + a patch_pid_overrides.py run. Deferred only because it is catalog surgery, not workflow.

card_no_pid:Promo Set 2|43.why: Stitch - Little Rocket — regional exclusive with no TCGplayer listing. Null pid is correct.

card_no_pid:Promo Set 3|59.why: Elsa - Exploring the Unknown. No TCGplayer SKU found. Same reasoning as PD1 #1: if one ever appears it surfaces as a missing_single, which is not acknowledged.

missing_single:711520.why: Mother Knows Best (Foil) promo #13 — same promo-printing decision as 711519.

sealed_no_set:543862.why: Illumineer's Quest: Deep Trouble box. Quest sets fold into EXTRAS_MAP rather than getting a sets row, so the box legitimately belongs to no set.

sealed_no_set:623065.why: Illumineer's Quest: Palace Heist box — same as Deep Trouble.

sealed_no_set:666352.why: Portfolio Bundle — an accessory, not tied to a set. Null set_id is correct.

sealed_no_set:702474.why: Curator's Collection: Heroines Edition. We DO have set_curators_cc1, so this one could be bound — a one-row update, low value on its own. Batch it with the next sealed cleanup.

unbound_group:24257.why: Illumineer's Quest: Palace Heist — same as Deep Trouble.

unbound_group:24740.why: Hyperia City (set 14). Prerelease 2026-10-16. Create the set and bind the group as part of the normal pre-release prestage, which is also what lets link_preorder_pids.py start walking it for singles.
